title: Strictly-Typed Zero-Dependency SSE Stream Decoder
description: Implement a zero-dependency, strictly-typed Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream parser for Node.js and modern Web environments with support for multi-line data, custom event names, IDs, retry intervals, and UTF-8 multi-chunk boundaries.
prompt:
You are a senior TypeScript engineer. Implement a zero-dependency SSE stream parser for browser and Node.js runtimes:

Requirements:
1. Define `export interface SSEMessage { id?: string; event: string; data: string; retry?: number; }`
2. Define `export class SSEDecoder` with `public push(chunk: string): SSEMessage[]` and `public reset(): void`.
3. Support multi-line `data:` fields joined with `\n`.
4. Default event name to `"message"` when not specified.
5. Lines starting with `:` must be ignored as comments.
6. Handle event dispatches on double newlines (`\n\n` and `\r\n\r\n`).
7. Handle chunks fragmented in the middle of UTF-8 strings or double newline delimiters.
